article.story: OGDEN, Utah -- — Aaron Powell’s 19 points helped Weber State defeat Tarleton State 89-87 in overtime on Tuesday night. Powell shot 5 of 14 from the field, including 4 for 9 from 3-point range, and went 5 for 6 from the free-throw line for the Wildcats (2-4). Dylan Warlick added 16 points and 11 rebounds while going 6 of 9 from the floor, including 0 for 3 from 3-point range, and 4 for 4 from the foul line. Mason Abittan went 7 of 15 from the field (2 for 7 from 3-point range) to finish with 16 points. Trey Harris led the way for the Texans (4-3) with 20 points and two steals. Tarleton State also got 16 points and two steals from JaVar Daniel. Leroy Kelly IV finished with 15 points, six rebounds, three steals and two blocks. Kelly hit a 3-pointer that made it 87-all with 16 seconds to play but Augustine Ekwe answered with a layup 9 seconds later that capped the scoring. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
